resources.string: Reads the caption, hashtags, and creator of the TikTok video on screen and automatically swipes past videos that match your blocklist. Also shows a small floating flag button so you can teach it new rage-bait patterns. Everything stays on this device — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Accessibility service: OFF — tap below to enable
If a general Accessibility page opens instead of this app\'s page: tap "Installed apps" → "RageBait Guard" → turn it On → Allow.
Auto-skipped: %1$d · Flagged with 😤: %2$d · Examples saved: %3$d · AI checks: %4$d
No custom terms yet — add words, phrases, or #hashtags above.
Terms seen in %1$d+ flagged videos start auto-skipping. Remove any that don\'t belong.
Nothing learned yet. In TikTok, tap the floating 😤 button on a rage-bait video to teach the guard.
Flag the same creator twice with 😤 and they land here automatically.
Ask AI when the blocklist isn\'t sure

When the local lists don\'t match, the guard screenshots the video, reads the on-screen text with on-device OCR, and asks a fast Gemini model \"related to any blocked topic, or obvious rage bait? Yes/No\". Roughly 10 cents per 1,000 videos and adds under a second. The default \"gemini-flash-lite-latest\" auto-updates to Google\'s newest cheap model, so it won\'t break when a version is retired; or pin one like \"gemini-3.1-flash-lite\". Only recognized text is sent to Google — never the screen image. If the call fails, nothing is skipped. Get a key at aistudio.google.com.
If the app crashes or misbehaves, open the logs and share them so the problem can be diagnosed. Crash stack traces are saved here automatically.

How it works: while TikTok is open, the guard reads the visible caption, hashtags, and creator handle. If they match anything above, it swipes to the next video for you (max 5 in a row, then it pauses — so it can never spiral). The floating 😤 button skips the current video AND saves it as a training example. All data stays on this phone. Works on both Z Fold screens — the button re-anchors when you fold or unfold.
